subject: Render parent aggregate system views over a resolved composition, referencing child artifacts and never overwriting them
description:
WHY: the spec's changes-across-repositories section: "A parent aggregate references child artifacts or renders a distinctly named system view; it never overwrites child-owned OpenAPI, SQL or interface documents." Its implementation prerequisites put aggregate projections after composition resolution.

GROUNDING:
- TARGETS: packages/core/src/project.ts:57-151.
- Output routing: packages/workspace/src/outputs.ts:94-95, :127-135.
- The diagram builders keep cross-model owner identity (task 12). Composition closure and the revision vector come from task 11; declared output claims from task 15.

CHANGE:
- A composition or mixed workspace renders system views over the resolved closure: component dependency across members, hosting, workflows and interactions, and the agreement map. They use distinct file names and a system scope.
- Child-owned records are referenced by member and path, never re-rendered as the parent's own artifact.
- Installation writes only into the parent's claimed output roots. A test proves a child-owned file is never written.
- Coverage accounts for imported records as references.

AREA TESTS: npm run build; core battery; node --test packages/workspace/dist/test/outputs.test.js; node --test packages/workspace/dist/test/composition.test.js.
WORKER: loom-worker (Sonnet 5, effort high, as its definition sets), resumed across its milestone while its context allows (task 1, warm reuse); Opus at xhigh only through `ledger escalate <task>` when the task proves complex, meaning an unresolved design question or a defect the worker cannot land (owner rule: prefer Sonnet; Opus xhigh only for complex work).
